verdict.rationale: The Apple M4 Pro is a hardware processor, so versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy are a category error for this product type. The developer frameworks in the pack (Metal, Core ML, MLX) belong to Apple's software platform, not the chip, and none of them documents a deprecation policy. The llms.txt probe returned 404 and is unrelated to API versioning.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy
